title: PlatformIO docs: boards_dir (board manifest lookup order: project boards_dir, core_dir/boards, platforms/*/boards)
note: Used by board.build_precheck to find the board manifest (build.mcu) the way PlatformIO does; PLATFORMIO_BOARDS_DIR replaces the project boards folder.

title: PlatformIO Core 6.2.0, platformio/package/manager/base.py: BasePackageManager.get_package (highest installed version that satisfies the requirement)
note: Read in the locally installed PlatformIO Core 6.2.0 (tag v6.2.0 exists upstream): get_package() skips installed packages whose version is not in spec.requirements and keeps the highest version. board.installed_platform and sim._offline_ready pick the espressif32 folder (espressif32 or espressif32@<version>) the same way.
